Foundational: Set and retrieve string values using SET and GET (overwrites existing values)



    
    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            

> SET bike:1 Deimos
OK
> GET bike:1
"Deimos"


            

            
            


            
            
                
                


















    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                        

                    
                

            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    GET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @read
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @fast
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Returns the string value of a key.
                            

                            
                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
                
                
                
                

                
                    
                        
                            Redis CLI guide
                        
                        

                            Also, check out our other client tools
                            Redis Insight
                            and
                            Redis for VS Code.
                        

                    
                
            
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


res1 = r.set("bike:1", "Deimos")
print(res1)  # True
res2 = r.get("bike:1")
print(res2)  # Deimos




            
            

            
            


            
            
                
                









    










    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    name: KeyT,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: EncodableT,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ex: Optional[ExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    px: Optional[ExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    nx: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    xx: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    keepttl: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    get: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    exat: Optional[AbsExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    pxat: Optional[AbsExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifeq: Optional[Union[bytes, str]] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifne: Optional[Union[bytes, str]] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifdeq: Optional[str] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifdne: Optional[str] = None
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                ResponseT
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    GET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @read
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @fast
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Returns the string value of a key.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            get(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    name: KeyT
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                ResponseT
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
              
              
                Python Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


const res1 = await client.set("bike:1", "Deimos");
console.log(res1);  // OK
const res2 = await client.get("bike:1");
console.log(res2);  // Deimos




            
            

            
            


            
            
                
                









    










    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            SET(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: RedisArgument,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: RedisArgument | number,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    options?: SetOptions
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                Any
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    GET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @read
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @fast
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Returns the string value of a key.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            GET(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: RedisArgument
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                Any
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
              
              
                Node.js Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


      String res1 = jedis.set("bike:1", "Deimos");
      System.out.println(res1); // OK
      String res2 = jedis.get("bike:1");
      System.out.println(res2); // Deimos




            
            

            
            


            
            
                
                









    










    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: byte[],
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: byte[]
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                String // simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly, or null if the SET operation was not performed because the user specified the NX or XX option but the condition was not met.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: byte[],
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: byte[],
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    params: SetParams // key if it already exists. EX|PX, expire time units: EX = seconds; PX = milliseconds
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                String // simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly, or null if the SET operation was not performed because the user specified the NX or XX option but the condition was not met.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: String,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: String
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                String // simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly, or null if the SET operation was not performed because the user specified the NX or XX option but the condition was not met.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: String,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: String,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    params: SetParams // key if it already exists. EX|PX, expire time units: EX = seconds; PX = milliseconds
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                String // simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly, or null if the SET operation was not performed because the user specified the NX or XX option but the condition was not met.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    GET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @read
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @fast
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Returns the string value of a key.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            get(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: String
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                String // Bulk reply
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
              
              
                Java-Sync Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


            CompletableFuture<Void> setAndGet = asyncCommands.set("bike:1", "Deimos").thenCompose(v -> {
                System.out.println(v); // >>> OK
                return asyncCommands.get("bike:1");
            })
                    .thenAccept(System.out::println) // >>> Deimos
                    .toCompletableFuture();




            
            

            
            


            
            
                
                









    










    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: K, // the key.
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: V // the value.
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                RedisFuture<String> // String simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: K, // the key.
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: V, // the value.
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    setArgs: SetArgs // the setArgs.
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                RedisFuture<String> // String simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    GET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @read
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @fast
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Returns the string value of a key.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            get(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: K // the key.
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                RedisFuture<V> // V bulk-string-reply the value of key, or null when key does not exist.
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
              
              
                Java-Async Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


            Mono<Void> setAndGet = reactiveCommands.set("bike:1", "Deimos").doOnNext(v -> {
                System.out.println(v); // OK
            }).flatMap(v -> reactiveCommands.get("bike:1")).doOnNext(res -> {
                System.out.println(res); // Deimos
            }).then();




            
            

            
            


            
            
                
                









    










    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    key: K, // the key.
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: V // the value.
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                Mono<String> // String simple-string-reply OK if SET was executed correctly.

                                                    key: K, // the key.

                                                    setArgs: SetArgs // the setArgs.

                                                    key: K
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                (Option<String>)
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            get(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    mut self: Any,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    get: bool
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                Self
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
              
              
                Rust-Async Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    












As you can see using the SET and the GET commands are the way we set
and retrieve a string value. Note that SET will replace any existing value
already stored into the key, in the case that the key already exists, even if
the key is associated with a non-string value. So SET performs an assignment.


Values can be strings (including binary data) of every kind, for instance you
can store a jpeg image inside a value. A value can't be bigger than 512 MB.


The SET command has interesting options that are provided as additional
arguments. For example, I may ask SET to fail if the key already exists,
or the opposite, that it only succeed if the key already exists:

Conditional SET operations: Use NX and XX options to control key existence when you need atomic compare-and-set behavior



    
    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            

# Recreate the bike:1 key so this example runs on its own.
> SET bike:1 Deimos
OK
> SET bike:1 bike NX
(nil)
> SET bike:1 bike XX
OK


            

            
            


            
            
                
                


















    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
                
                
                
                

                
                    
                        
                            Redis CLI guide
                        
                        

                            Also, check out our other client tools
                            Redis Insight
                            and
                            Redis for VS Code.
                        

                    
                
            
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


# Recreate the bike:1 key so this example runs on its own.
r.set("bike:1", "Deimos")

res3 = r.set("bike:1", "bike", nx=True)
print(res3)  # None
print(r.get("bike:1"))  # Deimos
res4 = r.set("bike:1", "bike", xx=True)
print(res4)  # True




            
            

            
            


            
            
                
                









    










    
    

        
            
                
                
                

                
                
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                    
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                

                

                    
                        

                            

                                
                                    SET
                                
                                
                                
                                    (
                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                            @write
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
                            

                            
                            
                            

                                
                                

                                    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        

                                            
                                            set(
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                                
                                                

                                                    name: KeyT,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    value: EncodableT,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ex: Optional[ExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    px: Optional[ExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    nx: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    xx: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    keepttl: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    get: bool = False,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    exat: Optional[AbsExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    pxat: Optional[AbsExpiryT] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifeq: Optional[Union[bytes, str]] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifne: Optional[Union[bytes, str]] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifdeq: Optional[str] = None,
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    ifdne: Optional[str] = None
                                                

                                                
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            ) → 
                                            
                                                ResponseT
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        
                                    
                                

                            

                            
                        

                    
                

            
        
    






            

            

            
              
              
                Python Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


// Recreate the bike:1 key so this example runs on its own.
await client.set("bike:1", "Deimos");

const res3 = await client.set("bike:1", "bike", {'NX': true});
console.log(res3);  // null
console.log(await client.get("bike:1"));  // Deimos
const res4 = await client.set("bike:1", "bike", {'XX': true});
console.log(res4);  // OK

                                            @write

                                            @string
                                        
                                    
                                        , 
                                        
                                        
                                            @slow
                                        
                                    
                                    )
                                
                                
                            

                            
                            Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type.       // Recreate the bike:1 key so this example runs on its own.
      jedis.set("bike:1", "Deimos");

      Long res3 = jedis.setnx("bike:1", "bike");
      System.out.println(res3); // 0 (because key already exists)
      System.out.println(jedis.get("bike:1")); // Deimos (value is unchanged)
      String res4 = jedis.set("bike:1", "bike", SetParams.setParams().xx()); // set the value to "bike" if it
      // already
      // exists
      System.out.println(res4); // OK

                Java-Sync Quick-Start
              
              


              

                
                
              

           
            

            

           
        


    
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        

            
            


            // Recreate the bike:1 key so this example runs on its own.
            CompletableFuture<Void> setnx = asyncCommands.set("bike:1", "Deimos")
                    .thenCompose(setup -> asyncCommands.setnx("bike:1", "bike")).thenCompose(v -> {
                        System.out.println(v); // >>> false (because key already exists)
                        return asyncCommands.get("bike:1");
                    })
                    .thenAccept(System.out::println) // >>> Deimos (value is unchanged)
                    .toCompletableFuture();
            setnx.join();

            // set the value to "bike" if it already exists
            CompletableFuture<Void> setxx = asyncCommands.set("bike:1", "bike", SetArgs.Builder.xx())
                    .thenAccept(System.out::println) // >>> OK
                    .toCompletableFuture();
            setxx.join();
